reason: The first order is all cash on delivery, so I lose nothing if they are liars. I would put several small kids' things in one parcel to try them once, but after that the 30% deposit up front would stop me.
objection: For small cheap things for the kids the fees eat everything: 13,000 a kilo plus the 3,000 minimum fee plus 5,000 delivery, so a 5,000 dinar toy ends up costing three times as much. And after the first order they want money before I see anything.
would_change_my_mind: Keep cash on delivery for every order, not only the first one, with no deposit.
